events.comment: Close < 300: shotgun | Mid 300-700: pistol | Long > 700: sniper. Skipped while dashing.
When player is practically touching (< 150px), dash away with dash_bwd. Cooldown 2s.
Sometimes dashes in (dash_fwd), knocks player back, then retreats (dash_bwd) further.
PlatformerObject handles walls automatically; Separate + tween-stop covers dash-tween clipping.
Right side (>800) dashes left, left side (<460) dashes right. Keeps it moving.
